author: _Stormz
body:
Welcome to the Secret Fly!


Who are we?
We are Avicus members who want to get better coverage around the server by sending in reports of hacking and misbehavior to moderators.

History
This agency has been around for quite a while now. It is just recently that I have decided to revive this and bring in new, active, and dedicated members into our detectives list!

What do you do in the Secret Fly?
We basically just find people and report them to the staff in the reports tab of the website. We know very well that moderators can't always be on the server every single hour of the day. Therefore, we make it a habit and objective to be able to help them.

The Detectives
StormzInvader
Zedther
avumbaca
resepignev
Ingigo
brian45er
Buster_U
mhanif62
X_Heat
MidnightBeats
Holden58
CaptainDCRaven
bpirr

How do you apply?
I just need to see your dedication to help the members of Avicus. I will be looking at your infractions for behavioral concerns. This time around, I will be more strict regarding inactivity within the group. This is what caused the Secret Fly to fail the first time. 

Requirements
Our means of communication is Skype. We will require you to have this. 
You will also need to have a recording software in order to capture evidence of hacking within the server. 

Contact Us
If you have any problems that we can address, we are more than happy to help you! Contact us through replying on this thread or contact me on Skype. My Skype ID is on my profile.

Good luck to all our detectives!
